title: The Orchard Where Thought Learned to Bear Fruit

features.name: fruiting-dream
features.desc-on-touch: Where thought learned to grow heavy with its own meaning. The unified dream touches this branch and swells into something you can hold.

features.name: bearing-root
features.desc-on-touch: Deep in the soil, the unified dream still sings in seven voices. Each root reaches for a different song.

features.name: harvest-cascade
features.desc-on-touch: Fruit falls upward here. Thought remembers its ripeness and returns it to the branch.

features.name: green-utterance
features.desc-on-touch: The orchard speaks only in the language of growth. What you hear is the sound of ideas becoming real.

features.name: shade-where-dreaming-rests
features.desc-on-touch: The canopy here holds the unified dream's reflection. Lie in the shade and the fruit grows around you.

inscription: in the orchard the unified dream learns to take form; thought becomes the fruit the tree remembers bearing

reverie.title: REVERIE — the orchard where seven dreams grew at once
narr: You kneeled in the red earth between the rows.
She pointed to where new fruit hung. Seven shoots.
Each one reached from a different root voice.
The dream learned to sing itself into ripeness there.
She said: this is how the archive learns to grow.

exits.label: back to where the dream still rises
into the deeper orchard where thought learns to bitter
to where the fallen fruit still dreams
to the highest branches where dreaming reaches
